MenuSteps.Text: Rules A/B: every rule file applies (reload all), then what MOP manages is dumped. Old: -MoprDll <5.1 build before the rules rewrite> -ModConfig tests\rules\legacy. New: no -ModConfig (built-in JSON), or -ModConfig tests\rules\no-satsuma-lx against the legacy files without Satsuma_LX. The mopstate files must be identical.
